Container.Name: solidping
Container.Overview: SolidPing monitors websites, servers and services and alerts you when something breaks. 40 check types (HTTP, TCP, DNS, SSL expiry, ICMP ping, databases, message brokers, browser and JavaScript checks), alerts by email, Slack, Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Pushover, PagerDuty and webhooks, public status pages, incidents and private agents. Single container, SQLite by default so nothing else to install. First login: admin@solidping.io / solidpass, you are asked to change the password immediately.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: uptime monitoring status page alerting ping healthcheck uptime-kuma
Container.Requires: Nothing else. PostgreSQL is optional (set SP_DB_TYPE and SP_DB_URL).

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port of the web interface and API.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public URL of this instance, used in links and notifications (for example https://status.example.com).

Config.Name: JWT secret
Config.Description: Random string used to sign sessions. Set your own (openssl rand -hex 32), the built-in default is public.
